The strip comparison the readiness lens proposed is: for each of the four files, `HEAD~1` and `HEAD` are identical after deleting spaces, tabs, newlines and commas (measured true for all four), and it catches a token change (measured: renaming `_argsByCallId` → `_argsByCallID` makes it differ). That comparison is the binding guard; `npm run typecheck` is secondary.
resolutions.evidence: Temp copy (removed): `biome check --write .` then commit; `git show --stat` listed the four src files with +/- counts; `git show -w --format= -- src/ | rg -c '^[-+][^-+]'` → 21; with `--ignore-blank-lines` → 21. For each src path: `[ "$(git show HEAD~1:$f | tr -d ' \t\n,')" = "$(git show HEAD:$f | tr -d ' \t\n,')" ]` → true ×4; negative control (one identifier changed) → false. `git show --word-diff=plain` shows the line joins and the dropped trailing commas.
